purpose: Truth-free identification audit of the single raw factor selected by Phase52: Android per-satellite carrier-frequency/antenna phase-bias residual. A native correction is authorized only if every frozen identifiability gate passes.

objective.factor: raw Android per-satellite carrier-phase ADR carrier-frequency/antenna phase-bias residual

phase52_result.use: factor-selection and policy metadata only; no Phase52 metric payload is an audit input

phase50_result.use: historical factor-policy metadata only; no Phase50 metric payload is an audit input

phase49_source_policy.use: ADR sign/temporal contract metadata only; no Phase49 metric payload is an audit input

phase41_sign_unit_audit.contract: Android PseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond is direct range-rate m/s; RINEX Doppler is -rate/wavelength

phase25_raw_contract.description: Use the existing Phase25 integer/Decimal raw-clock pseudorange contract only for raw eligibility; no coordinates, truth, or navigation are consumed.

raw_schema_contract.unknown_or_nonfinite_optional_values: reported and excluded from the affected relation; never imputed

fixed_physical_contract.raw_frequency_hz: CarrierFrequencyHz as reported by Android; no nominal replacement in the primary relation
fixed_physical_contract.nominal_frequency_hz: source constants for the parsed system/signal; frequency offset ppm=(CarrierFrequencyHz-f_nominal)/f_nominal*1e6
fixed_physical_contract.signed_adr_m: -AccumulatedDeltaRangeMeters only for the five published Samsung sign-correction models; Pixel5 preserves adapter ADR sign
fixed_physical_contract.adr_phase_cycles: phi_k = signed_ADR_k * CarrierFrequencyHz_k / c in the positive range-phase convention used for the ADR/rate relation; Android's RF CarrierPhase has the opposite sign (ADR = -k*carrier phase)
fixed_physical_contract.pair_eligibility: same system/SVID/signal adjacent Raw rows, 0<dt<=1.5 s, unchanged HardwareClockDiscontinuityCount, finite in-range Phase25 raw P, existing code/CN0/multipath masks clear, ADR valid with reset/cycle-slip bits clear
fixed_physical_contract.frequency_leakage_m: r_leak=(phi_k-phi_prev)*c/f_ref-(signed_ADR_k-signed_ADR_prev); this is the row-frequency-dependent component only
fixed_physical_contract.direct_phase_bias_residual_cycles: when CarrierPhase or CarrierCycles is present and finite, report the source-sign-consistent direct-vs-ADR phase relation (direct_phase_k + phi_k) after per-satellite/signal arc centering; CarrierPhase is fractional per Android and is never promoted to a full ambiguity
fixed_physical_contract.antenna_phase_bias: a direct antenna phase-center/bias field is required for an antenna interpretation; absence is a hard no-implementation finding, not a zero
fixed_physical_contract.clock_center: subtract the median signed residual in each endpoint utcTimeMillis+HardwareClockDiscontinuityCount group for robust non-common-mode reporting; retain raw and centered values
fixed_physical_contract.normalization: report cycles and metres using the observed pair f_ref; no coordinates, satellite geometry, truth, nav, or WLS
fixed_physical_contract.sign_source: Phase41 direct Android range-rate and existing Pixel5 ADR sign contract; Android GnssMeasurement defines accumulated delta range = -k*carrier phase; synthetic sign fixture is mandatory

controls_and_repeats.control: constant-frequency ADR/rate residual computed from the same in-memory eligible pairs
controls_and_repeats.repeat_policy: no second raw read; deterministic arithmetic and aggregate invariants are recomputed from the one in-memory parse
controls_and_repeats.route_leave_one_out: recompute fixed aggregate effect after omitting each route without opening raw input again
controls_and_repeats.implementation_policy: if all gates pass, authorize one opt-in native C++ FGO/TDCP correction concept only after a separate implementation seal; otherwise implement nothing

numeric_gates.logic: AND; thresholds, formulas, controls, and source-availability policy are immutable after this freeze and before the first Phase53 raw read

source_decision_policy.all_pass: Authorize only one separately sealed opt-in native C++ FGO/TDCP correction design; do not read truth or run accuracy in Phase53.
source_decision_policy.any_fail: No correction, mask, weighting, solver rerun, or truth read. Record the strongest raw-only structure and exactly one next source-supported factor.
source_decision_policy.antenna_field_absent: Do not invent an antenna phase-center/bias term. Report the exact per-route header absence and evaluate only raw CarrierFrequencyHz/ADR relationships; native correction remains unauthorized.
source_decision_policy.phase52_champion: Preserve Phase43 champion and Phase51 experimental option regardless of Phase53 outcome.
